brief: A quiet Copenhagen strength and mobility studio for busy adults who want measured, human training rather than a loud gym or a clinical treatment setting.
status: concept project — not a real business

concept.name: Calibrated K
concept.idea: A stable K with a precise measure point at its centre.
rationale: One vertical datum and two mirrored diagonals make the mark look built rather than drawn.
The point ties the identity to assessment before training, without a gym cliché.
The structure holds at favicon size and in one colour.

slides: The mark — construction and the point
Lockups — horizontal, stacked, wordmark, clear space
Sizes and colour — 120 px minimum, four colour pairs
In use — header, app icon, door sign, workwear tag
